{{Quote|We lost Gold Leader.|Gold Two|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />}}
'''Gold Two''' was the call sign of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. He took command of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] after [[Gold Leader (Muunilinst)|Gold Leader's]] death.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />

==Biography==
As the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|battle over]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] began a huge number of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian starfighters]] joined the battle, Gold Leader was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while the rest of Gold Squadron was being decimated. Gold Two took immediate command after Gold Leader's death. After informing [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of enemy reinforcements coming from point 3 5, Gold Squadron was ordered to get out of there by Commander Skywalker.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />
